podcast.title: The Planning Desk
podcast.description: Fifteen minutes of supply chain planning and design news every Sunday, with a focus on the Nordics and the DACH region: disruptions, trade and macro signals, planning technology and AI, real company use cases and the events worth your time.
podcast.ai_disclosure: The Planning Desk is produced with AI. AI agents gather and summarise the week's news from public sources, and the hosts' voices are synthetic.
podcast.author: The Planning Desk

jingles.intro_prompt: Modern news podcast intro, 10 seconds, instrumental. Confident pulsing synth bass, crisp electronic percussion, bright rising piano motif, polished broadcast feel. Builds quickly and resolves cleanly on the last beat.
jingles.outro_prompt: Modern news podcast outro, 10 seconds, instrumental. Same sound as the intro: pulsing synth bass, crisp electronic percussion, bright piano motif. Settles down and ends on a clean final chord with a short natural decay.
